summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/web3.js with unverified bundled code
details: Package name @solana-labs/web3js closely resembles the widely-used @solana/web3.js SDK (scope substitution plus removal of the dot), which is a recognized confusion vector. The shipped bundles lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js are large, minified files that contain require('child_process'), https.get, and multiple fetch/POST call sites. Pattern matches on keyword co-occurrence in minified code cannot by themselves distinguish a legitimate SDK bundle from an exfiltration payload, and the specific destinations and call graphs were not fully traced. Given the strong name-similarity to a top Solana ecosystem package and unverified bundled network/process-spawn primitives, a human reviewer should confirm whether this is a legitimate fork/mirror or a confusion-attack package before allowing installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
